verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager has no separate GUI. Its entire surface is a documented, scriptable CLI covering install, add, remove, update, dedupe, prune, audit/fix, outdated, why, info, link, pack and publish, so an agent can drive every capability headlessly. The one interactive mode (`update --interactive`) has non-interactive equivalents, such as updating a named package directly. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md docs) further support AI-native use. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic (library or HTTP) API beyond the CLI (OpenAPI probes all 404), an explicit vendor statement of interface parity, and independent hands-on corroboration of fully scripted agent workflows.
